speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, what specific changes have you noticed in your mental state over the past two days alongside your fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS). 

Given your age, fever, altered mental status, and current use of haloperidol, I suspect NMS triggered by your medication history with tics. I will now request a Creatine Kinase (CK) level to confirm muscle involvement.
